correctness.rationale: Let m=|X| and x0 in X; add q=n+1-m points mutually at distance R and at distance R+d_X(x0,x) from each old x. All triangle inequalities hold, the strict R<sep(X) makes minimum separation of Y exactly R, and |Y|=n+1. Identity on X plus mapping all new points to x0 is a full correspondence of distortion exactly R; any correspondence from Y to <=n points must pair two distinct Y points to the same image, forcing distortion >=minsep(Y)=R. Thus d_GH(X,Y)=dist(Y,M<=n)=R/2; the open GH ball about Y of radius R/2 avoids the stratum and lies inside B(X,R). A separated (n+1)-point subset gives the closure argument, finite epsilon nets show density, and countable union of closed nowhere dense strata gives meagreness. An independently exhaustive finite X2/Y3 correspondence calculation found min distortion R=1 over 25 surjective correspondences. The general claim rests on the correspondence proof, not that example.
